newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Euroyen futures edge up on JGB gains.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Euroyen futures edge up on JGB gains.

text.p: SIMEX Euroyen futures inched higher on the back of a sharp rise in Japanese government bond (JGB) futures on Friday as players covered their positions after the previous day's drop.

"There was short-covering ahead of the weekend but the Japanese players were also looking to squeeze out some of the shorts from yesterday," said a trader with a European house, He said U.S. hedge funds had been aggressive JGB sellers on Thursday.
Stop-loss buying was also triggered below 125.80 and then above 125.90 in the March JGB contract, he added.
"The domestics do have money they need to put to work and I'm not sure they see huge opportunities in the Nikkei," he said, adding that supply conditions also favoured the bond market.
March JGBs settled at 125.93 against their previous 125.68 after hitting a high of 125.98.
Dealers said Euroyen futures had a lacklustre session with the September contract quoted at 99.35 at 1112 GMT against its IMM close at 99.33. December was at 99.24 against 99.21.
"The expectations of a rate hike have now been pushed back until March 1998. I'm not sure that's wise but you can't go against the market," said the trader.
Dealers said the release of Japan's indices of leading and coincident indicators for December had no impact on the market as they were in line with expectations.
Eurodollar futures finished little changed in light dealings as no significant U.S. economic indicators were due on Friday.
June Eurodollars ended flat against their IMM close at 94.40 on volume of 6,415 lots.
